title: Salinity and Ionic Stress
word_count_method: Whitespace-separated tokens in p.teaching-prose after markup removal; excludes headings, questions, tables, figures, bibliography, revision, navigation and metadata.
comparison: 6.C.04 Amino Acid Biosynthesis and Carbon-Nitrogen Integration: 13,056 words under identical extraction; 6.H.05: 14,017 words.
coverage: Osmotic and ionic phases; Na and Cl toxicity; potassium homeostasis; SOS signaling; HKT retrieval; NHX and proton gradients; osmolytes; halophyte strategies and salt glands; glycophytes; saline/sodic soils; Na/K data and iso-osmotic controls. Revised CSIR-UGC-DBT Unit 6.H and older CSIR/MP SET explicit salt stress.
coverage_matrix: soil data classification and remediation principles
Na/K data, iso-osmotic comparisons, genotype effects, recovery

review.scientific: Reviewed selected syllabus and source records (Munns & Tester; Qiu et al.; Bassil et al.; wheat HKT Nax2; halophyte reviews; van Zelm et al.; FAO). Distinguished tissue-specific HKT and vacuolar K/pH roles of NHX from blanket sodium-exclusion claims. Recomputed osmotic potentials -0.4955144 and -0.2477572 MPa, Na inward free energy -17.283 kJ/mol, EK -118.253 mV, H+ chemical energy -11.40964 kJ/mol, mass ratio 2.00087, RWC 75%, leakage 20%, Fv/Fm .65, SAR 8, ESP 15 and efflux 6; reviewed answer logic and illustrative data labeling.
review.editorial: Separate review of 16-section learning progression, 134 distinct teaching paragraphs, captions, question wording and explanations, revision resources and reader compatibility. Revised 26 question sets, distributed correct positions equally, retained reader controls, checked SVG/ARIA/anchor targets and improved zoom focus return.

score_basis: Internal evidence-based self-assessment; deductions for selective source verification, complexity of some passages, static-only figure inspection, some simpler distractors and lack of interactive/accessibility runtime testing. Not external peer review.
limitations: Desktop/mobile interactive rendering, keyboard and screen-reader runtime not tested.

Selected source records and syllabus checked; exhaustive full-text source verification and independent peer review not performed. MP SET checked through reproduced 2024 PDF, latest official MPPSC copy not independently confirmed.
Pages deployment and live content must be verified separately.
